meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 推进计划执行,并行调度多个子代理完成工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你制定好计划后希望一键执行并分派给子代理
copy.tagline_en: Execute your plan and orchestrate parallel subagents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a detailed plan and want to execute it with subagents.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会变成调度员:把你批准的计划拆成小任务,派给多个虚拟助手并行执行,自己只负责分配、跟进和验收,不直接写代码或改文件,并持续记录进度直到全部完成。
howto.when: 在规划完成后,当你说出 'start work'、'execute plan'、'continue plan' 等指令,或要求执行 .omo/plans 下的某一计划时触发。

say.note: 继续当前未完成的计划。

say.text: 用 --ship 模式执行当前计划
say.note: 会一直跟进到 PR 合并。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: it breaks an approved plan into small tasks, dispatches them to parallel subagents, monitors results, records progress, and never implements code itself.
howto.when_en: After planning, triggers when the user says 'start work', 'execute plan', 'continue plan', etc., or asks to run a plan under .omo/plans.

say_en.text: start work, execute the plan in .omo/plans/refactor.md
run the current plan in --ship mode
